about.title: Making legal advice easier and safer to access
about.body: Qanony is an Egyptian technology platform that helps individuals and businesses find verified lawyers, book consultations and order legal services at clear prices — with tools that protect lawyer–client confidentiality. We also give lawyers and law firms an integrated workspace for appointments, matters, documents and payments.
about.mission: That everyone in Egypt can find the right lawyer for their problem, with confidence and fee transparency, without giving up their privacy.
about.value1: We only grant the verified badge after actually reviewing bar registration details.
about.value2: Permissions are designed so only the people you authorise can see your data.
about.value3: Published fees, a clear refund policy, and rankings that advertising cannot buy.
about.notAFirm: Qanony is not a law firm and does not itself give legal advice; registered lawyers provide their services independently under their professional obligations.

legal.privacyBody:
## Who we are

Qanony operates a technology service connecting clients with lawyers. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data.

## Data we collect

- Account data: name, email, phone number, preferred language.
- Booking data: consultation type, time, and the issue summary you write.
- Documents and messages you share with your lawyer.
- Payment data: transaction reference and status only; card details are processed by the payment gateway and never stored by us.
- Technical data: security logs and IP addresses for protection and fraud prevention.

## How we use data

- To run bookings, payments and notifications.
- To enable secure communication between you and your lawyer.
- For legal and accounting obligations and fraud prevention.

## Confidentiality

Only the parties and people you authorise can access your messages and documents. Support staff cannot open them. In disputes, administrators only see documents you choose to attach as evidence.

## Artificial intelligence

We never process your documents with AI tools without your explicit consent, and we do not use your data to train models.

## Sharing

We share the minimum data necessary with service providers (hosting, payments, messaging, video calls) under agreements requiring them to protect it.

## Retention and deletion

We keep data for the life of your account and as long as accounting laws require. You can request account deletion from your settings.

## Your rights

You may access, correct, request deletion of and object to processing of your data under Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 and its executive regulations.

## Contact

For privacy questions, reach us through the Contact page.
legal.termsBody:
## Nature of the service

Qanony is a technology platform, not a law firm. Registered lawyers provide their services independently with full professional responsibility; the platform does not give legal advice or guarantee any outcome.

## Accounts

- Information you provide must be accurate and up to date.
- You are responsible for keeping your password secret and for activity on your account.

## Lawyers

- Lawyers must follow the rules and ethics of the profession and keep client information confidential.
- The verified badge is only granted after the platform reviews bar registration details and may be withdrawn for violations.
- Lawyers must honour the fees shown on their profile and their stated cancellation policy.

## Booking and payment

- Paid bookings are only confirmed after the payment gateway confirms payment.
- Cancellations and refunds follow the Refund Policy.

## Reviews

Reviews are only allowed after a completed service. Confidential or abusive content is prohibited and may be withheld.

## Prohibited use

Using the platform for unlawful activity, impersonation or attempts to access others' data is prohibited.

## Liability

To the extent permitted by law, the platform is not responsible for the content of advice given by lawyers.

## Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.
legal.refundBody:
## Cancellation by the client

- Before the lawyer's deadline (24 hours by default): full refund.
- After the deadline but before the appointment: a partial refund per platform settings (50% by default).
- After the appointment starts, or for no-shows: no refund.

## Cancellation by the lawyer

Always a full refund.

## Unconfirmed requests

If the lawyer does not confirm before the appointment time, it is cancelled automatically and fully refunded.

## Fixed-price services

- Cancel with a full refund before the lawyer starts work.
- After delivery you can request included revisions or open a dispute within the stated period.

## Disputes

Either party can open a dispute within 14 days of the consultation. Administrators decide after reviewing the evidence provided, which may result in a full or partial refund.

## Refund timing

Refunds go back to the original payment method and may take 5–14 business days to appear, depending on your bank or wallet.
